title: Aureline M5 learning-mode-toggle component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the learning-mode-toggle family binds inside the frozen M5 learning-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-learning-component-matrix.schema.json). A learning-mode toggle names whether learning mode is engaged and how widely it applies so learning stays opt-in and never traps an expert in a tutorial. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-learning is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
